sourceTitle: Fostering payments, allowances and benefits (Central Bedfordshire Council)

fees.label: Tier one (first two years of fostering)
Tier two (fostering for over two years)

feesNote: Central Bedfordshire pays a weekly foster care fee for each child on top of the child allowance, rising after two years of fostering.
extras: Annual birthday allowance equal to one week's child allowance
Annual holiday allowance equal to two weeks' child allowance
Welcome fee of £1,000 for newly approved mainstream carers
Long service payment of £500 after five years, rising by £500 for each further five years
£1,000 for referring someone who becomes an approved foster carer
summary: Central Bedfordshire pays a weekly child allowance by age plus a flat weekly fee for the carer, which rises from £100 to £175 after two years. The council's page does not state which year the rates apply to, so check the current figures with the fostering team before you apply.
